title: Néonatal Early-Onset sepsis calculateur
formula:
The model coefficients to calculate early-onset sepsis (EOS) risk at birth are as follows:

| Variable | Transformation | Coefficient |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gestational age (GA), weeks | ga | -6.9325 |
| ga 2 | 0.0877 | |
| Temperature, °F | temp | 0.8680 |
| Duration of rupture of membranes (ROM), hours | trom = (rom + 0.05) 0.2 | 1.2256 |
| Group B S treptococcus (GBS) positive | yes = 1, no = 0 | 0.5771 |
| GBS unknown | yes = 1, no = 0 | 0.0427 |
| Broad-spectrum antibiotics >4 hrs prior to birth | yes = 1, no = 0 | -1.1861 |
| Broad-spectrum antibiotics 2-3.9 hrs prior to birth | yes = 1, no = 0 | -1.0488 |
| GBS-specific antibiotics >2 hrs prior to birth | yes = 1, no = 0 | -1.0488 |
| Constant | | 40.5656 |

**EOS risk at birth** = 1/(1 + e^-x^),

where **x** = Σ[β*(transformed variables)]

**EOS risk per 1000/births** = (EOS risk at birth)*1000

EOS risk after clinical exam is calculated as follows:

**EOS risk per 1000/births** = y/(1 + y) * 1000,

where **y** = z*[EOS risk at birth/(1 - EOS risk at birth)]

z is defined as follows:

| Clinical Exam | z |
| --- | --- |
| Well-appearing | 0.41 |
| Equivocal | 5 |
| Clinical illness | 21.2 |

how_to_use.why: Aide à identifier les nouveau-nés à risque de sepsis à début précoce.
how_to_use.when:
- Utiliser à la naissance pour déterminer le risque de sepsis néonatal précoce.
- Nécessite les informations cliniques maternelles ainsi qu’un examen physique du nouveau-né.
how_to_use.pearls:
- L'examen physique doit être réalisé dans les 12-24 premières heures suivant la naissance.
- Ne doit être utilisé que pour l'évaluation des nouveau-nés nés ≥34 semaines de gestation.
- Cet outil utilise l'incidence nationale du CDC de 0.5/1000 naissances vivantes. L'incidence locale de sepsis néonatal précoce peut varier.

next_steps.advice: Ce calculateur utilise l’incidence nationale du CDC du sepsis néonatal précoce (0.5/1000 naissances vivantes). Votre incidence locale peut être plus élevée ou plus faible ; veillez à suivre les recommandations locales.
next_steps.management:
- In addition to calculating a numerical risk level, this calculator makes recommendations for follow-up care of the newborn.
- If no additional care is recommended (i.e., no blood culture or antibiotics), the newborn can likely be observed with routine vitals.
- If a blood culture is recommended, the newborn should have vitals obtained every 4 hours.
- If empiric antibiotics are recommended, consider NICU evaluation and transfer.

more_info:
Definitions of clinical exam:

Well-appearing: No persistent physiologic abnormalities.

Equivocal: One of the below physiologic abnormalities present for ≥4 hours OR ≥2 of the below physiologic abnormalities present for ≥2 hours.

- Tachycardia (HR ≥160).
- Tachypnea (RR ≥60).
- Temperature instability (≥100.4 F or <97.5 F).
- Respiratory distress (grunting, flaring, or retracting) but not requiring supplemental oxygen.

Critical illness: Any one of the below clinical findings.

- Need for NCPAP/HFNC/mechanical ventilation outside of the delivery room.
- Hemodynamic instability requiring vasoactive medication.
- Neonatal encephalopathy/perinatal depression, characterized by seizure or Apgar score @ 5 minutes <5.
- Need for supplemental oxygen ≥2 hours to maintain oxygen saturations >90%.
medium_description: Calculates néonatal early-onset sepsis risque basé sur maternal intrapartum risque factors.

input_schema.label: Température maternelle antepartum la plus élevée

input_schema.label: Type d’antibiotiques per-partum
input_schema.tips: Si des antibiotiques à large spectre et des antibiotiques spécifiques du GBS ont tous deux été administrés en per-partum, veuillez sélectionner le moment approprié parmi les catégories à large spectre.
